items.summary: LiDAR is a critical sensor for autonomous driving and robotics, yet it remains vulnerable to adverse conditions such as fog, rain, transparent objects, and low-reflectance surfaces. items.description: We rarely notice what's closest to us. Perspective is hard to gain, but it is worth cultivating. Here's how. The post Book Recommendation: Life in Perspective appeared first on Scott H Young .
items.summary: An old fish swims by two young fish and says, “Morning boys, how’s the water?” After he passes by, one young fish looks at the other and says, “What the heck is water?” The joke points to an important truth: we rarely notice what’s closest to us. The traits we have that are most obvious to others are often invisible to us.
